def create_gear(teeth=12, outer_radius=10, inner_radius=7, height=5, center_hole_radius=3):

        # Position tooth at correct radius (midpoint of tooth radial position)
        tooth_radius = inner_radius + (outer_radius - inner_radius) / 2
        tooth.apply_translation([tooth_radius, 0, -height/2])

        tooth.apply_transform(rot_mat)
        
        meshes.append(tooth)
    
    # Combine all parts

    gear.merge_vertices()
    
    # Create center hole using boolean difference

    print(f"\nGear created with {teeth} teeth and {center_hole_radius}mm center hole")
